title: Machu Picchu built
summary: An Inca citadel was built high on a ridge, probably as an estate for Pachacuti; radiocarbon dates place its use c. 1420-1530.
why: One of the most iconic symbols of the Inca civilization.

notes.problem: Its own summary shows the c. 1450 date is contested by radiocarbon (occupation c. 1420-1530); 'most famous symbol' is stronger than source ('one of the most iconic symbols').
